versions.changelog:
- Added new reference file `references/mcp.md` as the authoritative source for MCP execution, project/record queries, and stake-redeem confirmation.
- Updated skill description to clarify core LaunchPool operations and trigger phrases.
- Instructed to strictly follow `references/mcp.md` for MCP mode, with `SKILL.md` focused on routing and semantics.
- No changes to module coverage, core workflow, or tool definitions.
- General clarifications to text, trigger guidance, and internal document routing.

Gate LaunchPool Suite skill initial release.

- Supports browsing ongoing, upcoming, or past LaunchPool projects with various filter options.
- Enables staking tokens to LaunchPool projects and redeeming staked assets.
- Allows users to view personal participation (pledge) history and airdrop reward records.
- Includes detailed routing and parameter extraction logic for handling requests.
- Requires Gate API key with Launch:Write permission.
